jess: Idea dump 5: we'd add a short verification window for auto-fallbacks. Instead of immediate full switch, route a small canary slice to the fallback path (cheap/quantized model or degraded feature) and validate SLO impact before widening. Anyone opposed?
omar: +1. We should make verification aware of SLOs: e.g., only consider proceeding if latency p95 stays within X% and error-rate doesn't exceed Y. Also track user-visible metrics, not just infra.
tiffany: UX thoughts 6: show the verification window as a vertical 'hold' in the rollout timeline with live micro-metrics: sample ratio, SLO delta, recent traceIDs. Allow one-click promote or abort.
nick: Implementation notes: need an atomic handoff record so operators can replay exactly what was routed. We should stamp each sampled request with rollout_id and canary_step so it's queryable in tracing. Also quota accounting: sampled traffic still consumes normal billing and capacity; surface expected cost impact in UI.
jess: can we support parallel strategies? e.g., degrade to cheaper model OR task-shed (reduce features) depending on trigger class. Policy editor should list strategy types and their quick-effects.
omar: error triggers: classify into transient (timeout spikes), persistent (model degradation), and catastrophic (auth/gpu OOM). For catastrophic, skip verification and move to immediate safe-mode or circuit-breaker. For transient, do verification with a short retry backoff.
tiffany: operator inbox design: cards grouped by service, each card shows verification progress, mini-chart, buttons: escalate (take over), promote (complete), rollback, annotate. Include a 'simulate impact' link that runs the policy against recent traffic sample and shows projected SLO changes.
nick: oscillation risk 7: add cool-down: once a policy exits verification (either successfully or aborted), ignore retriggers for N minutes. Also limit to one active verification per service per policy to avoid overlapping canaries.
jess: audit trail 8: every policy decision, simulation, and operator action must create an immutable event record with a short human summary + machine payload (json blob). Retention default 90d, with an enterprise toggle for 1y export. Events should surface in service-level compliance view.
omar: telemetry: emit compact verification events that include step, sample_pct, baseline vs observed metrics, and sample traceIDs up to M entries. Keep full KV traces only if operator flags the event for forensic export.
tiffany: UI affordance: add tiny state pill next to policy name: idle / verifying / blocked / degraded / failed. Hover shows last verification summary. Also allow quick filtering in the rollout table for policies currently verifying.
ops-bot: sim-run complete -> service=convo-gen, policy=verify-window-alpha, run=sim-176300-1, results: projected p95 +3.5%, error-rate delta +0.05pp, cost delta +0.9%. link: https://staging.console/redwood/sims/176300-1
jess: perfect. Omar/Nick, can you draft the telemetry schema and the minimal tracing stamp? Tiffany, can you sketch the inbox card and pill states? I'll consolidate into a spec doc and add a short ops playbook for reading verification outputs.
omar: on it. I'll include mapping for error classes and recovery actions.
nick: will post trace stamping PR and a proposal for cost-estimate calc.
tiffany: I'll drop mocks by EOD and attach here.
ops-bot: Note: feature-flag verify-window enabled in staging for rollout UX experiments.
